assumptions: exchangeable independent group representatives; arbitrary regional shift not covered
basis: overlapping macro-region, information tier, peak-overlap, historical-heat, dam and zero-flow group proxies; no hidden target labels
full_region_basis: held region absent from source calibration; full/empty randomized set, or conservative full set; no singleton release
guarantee_target: conditional prediction-set coverage, hence false-admission frequency per eligible case; NOT failure probability conditional on release
randomization: independent uniform dual weight per case; exact tilted boundary LP; monotone endpoint caching with conservative <=1e-8 numerical enlargement
sampling: one uniform case per unique source rule-calibration group; held group never in calibration
score: binary LAC abs(failure-risk_score), not a one-sided regression residual
solver_fallback: equivalent tilted finite-basis boundary LP; mathematical unboundedness distinguished from numerical failure
source: Gibbs, Cherian, Candes JRSSB 2025; authors' conditionalconformal exact finite-dimensional implementation
support_test: nonrandomized active binary membership needs tau/(1-tau) representatives; randomized dual-weight bounds handled separately
unsupported_or_solver_failure: full {no failure, failure} set on numerical failure; explicit status and no release
